chunks.title: About - Muhammet Veysi Kahraman
chunks.content: Muhammet Veysi Kahraman is a data scientist who designs end-to-end artificial intelligence products by combining mathematical theories with machine learning algorithms. He completed his undergraduate education in the Mathematics Department at Bolu Abant Izzet Baysal University (BAIBU) and specializes in Natural Language Processing (NLP, LLM, AI Agents), Image Processing, Machine Learning, and Data Science. Regardless of the industry, he actively conducts research in every branch of machine learning and deep learning. He dedicates time to both personal projects and competitions, constantly applying his theoretical knowledge in practice. In project development, he uses lightweight and interpretable approaches for traditional ML problems, and modern deep learning architectures for complex AI and autonomous systems (AI Agents). Title: JR. AI Developer. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammetveysikahraman/, GitHub: https://github.com/mveysi, Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/mveysikahraman

chunks.title: Education
chunks.content: Muhammet Veysi Kahraman completed his undergraduate degree in Mathematics Engineering Program (BSc.) at Bolu Abant Izzet Baysal University (BAIBU). Study period: 2021 - 2026. GPA: 3.09 / 4.0.

chunks.title: Experience - Inosens
chunks.content: Muhammet Veysi Kahraman worked as an AI Developer at Inosens from September 2025 to June 2026. Responsibilities: Developing time series forecasting models (Prophet, ARIMA, SARIMA) on production data. Performing data cleaning and feature extraction on wearable sensor signals using NeuroKit. Designing machine learning models to predict patient scores in gamified physiotherapy. Training computer vision models via PyTorch and MediaPipe to assess exercise accuracy. Analyzing pediatric clinical datasets and developing custom ML algorithms for academic research (Aktives project). Technologies: Python, Prophet, ARIMA, SARIMA, NeuroKit, PyTorch, MediaPipe, Machine Learning.

chunks.title: Experience - Imona Technologies
chunks.content: Muhammet Veysi Kahraman worked as an AI Developer at Imona Technologies Inc. from April to May 2025. He automated social media content workflows utilizing Make.com and AI Agent integrations. Technologies: Make.com, Automation, AI Agent, Social Media.

chunks.title: Experience - Venator UAV
chunks.content: Muhammet Veysi Kahraman was a member of the IBU Venator UAV Software Team from 2023 to 2025. He developed real-time UAV fire detection models and optimized object detection algorithms (YOLO, CNN) for edge deployment on Raspberry Pi. He also worked on autonomous landing and takeoff systems. Technologies: Python, YOLO, OpenCV, Deep Learning, Raspberry Pi, CNN, R-CNN.

chunks.title: GitHub Projects
chunks.content: Muhammet Veysi Kahraman's GitHub profile (github.com/mveysi) contains various machine learning and deep learning projects since 2023. Notable projects: Feature-Engineering-Diabetes (diabetes prediction), Heart-Diseases-Machine-Learning (heart disease prediction), Breast-Cancer-ML (breast cancer detection), Lung-Disease-CNN (lung disease detection with CNN), Stress-Machine-Learning (stress level prediction), Advertising-Machine-Learning (advertising effectiveness prediction), Salary-Machine-Learning (salary prediction), House-Price-ML (house price prediction), Feature-Engineering-TelcoChurn (customer churn feature engineering). Technologies: Python, Deep Learning, CNN, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras.

chunks.title: Kaggle Projects
chunks.content: Muhammet Veysi Kahraman actively works on data science and machine learning projects on Kaggle (kaggle.com/mveysikahraman) since 2023. Projects focus on classification and computer vision. Notable projects: Classification + PCA (classification and dimensionality reduction), Brain-Tumor MRI + CNN (brain tumor detection). Technologies: Python, CNN, PCA, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras.

chunks.title: Competition - BTK Datathon 2024
chunks.content: Muhammet Veysi Kahraman participated in the BTK Datathon 2024 competition. Category: Machine Learning. The aim of the competition was to develop a model that predicts whether new applicants will be accepted as scholars using the real data of the Entrepreneurship Foundation, contributing as a decision support mechanism to the scholarship selection process.

chunks.title: Competition - Zindi Amini Cacao Disease Detection
chunks.content: Muhammet Veysi Kahraman participated in the Zindi / Amini Cacao Disease Detection Challenge. Category: Computer Vision. The goal was to detect diseases of cacao plants in Africa using YOLO. He is currently ranked 7th in Africa in this competition together with his teammate.

chunks.title: Presentations - AI and AI Agent Seminar
chunks.content: Muhammet Veysi Kahraman organized and delivered a seminar on AI and AI Agents for the Mathematics Department at Bolu Abant Izzet Baysal University (BAIBU) in 2026. The seminar covered artificial intelligence and AI Agent technologies.
